AgroYordam 0.1 — Android APK (test versiyasi).

O'rnatish: APK faylni telefonga yuklab oling va oching ("Noma'lum manbalardan o'rnatish"ga ruxsat bering).
Agar APK server manzilisiz yig'ilgan bo'lsa, birinchi ekrandagi "Server: ..." tugmasi orqali backend manzilini kiriting.
Repo Settings → Variables → `API_URL` berilsa, APK shu serverga o'zi ulanadi.
